legacyCompatibility.guarantee: Every value admitted by a named v1 protocol preserves the byte representation produced by its corresponding pre-contract serializer. The shared Action subset is byte-identical across the pre-contract Python and nlohmann serializers.
legacyCompatibility.floatingPointBoundary: The cross-language Action and strict Workspace protocols reject every float. The Python identity protocol preserves the exact finite-float bytes produced by the pre-contract Python serializer and rejects non-finite pseudo-JSON tokens.
legacyCompatibility.readerBoundary: Existing persisted payloads and manifests remain readable and retain their stored hashes. Cross-language Action and Workspace identities must use integers or string-encoded decimal quantities; Python-owned identities retain legacy finite-float bytes.
legacyCompatibility.successorRule: A future cross-language protocol that admits floating point must use a new protocol id and define migration and legacy-reader behavior.
